This diff-grounded change means non-calendar integrations (e.g., video/meeting references) will be persisted without a `credentialId`, which can break downstream logic that relies on `bookingVideoReference.credentialId` to look up credentials for cleanup/deletion. The diff does not show handleCancelBooking’s video deletion guard itself, but the loss of `credentialId` for non-calendar references is clearly introduced here and is plausibly a functional regression.
